governing_rule: Typing may increase legibility and mechanical checkability. It may not increase semantic standing.

invariants.rule: every claim evidence_ref MUST resolve to evidence[]
every authority basis_evidence_ref MUST resolve to evidence[]
TRANSFER_ASSERTED requires at least one basis_evidence_ref and non-null target_authority_ref
NOT_TRANSFERRED requires empty basis_evidence_refs and null target_authority_ref
a claim dimension MUST NOT also appear in non_claims
each unresolved dimension other than OTHER MUST appear in revalidation_required, mapping AUTHORITY->AUTHORITY
disclosure_state UNAVAILABLE requires access_status UNAVAILABLE and locator null
disclosure_state FULL requires access_status AVAILABLE and non-null locator
claim_basis RECOMPUTED requires at least one evidence_ref
claim dimension INDEPENDENT_WITNESSING is forbidden in this semantic-core object
authority TRANSFER_ASSERTED cannot coexist with AUTHORIZATION as an explicit non-claim
